metaDescription: Order custom bucket sunhats for your team or event. Wide brims, UPF protection, and full-color imprint. Perfect for outdoor branding.
introHtml: Bucket sunhats offer full 360-degree sun protection with a soft, packable crown that travels well. Unlike rigid wide-brim hats, bucket styles fold flat for storage and come in cotton, nylon, or polyester blends. They are ideal for outdoor events, field crews, and summer giveaways where comfort and coverage matter. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery on the front or crown for a clean, readable logo.
heroAltText: Custom bucket sunhats with wide brim and embroidered logo for outdoor corporate events
